data.body:
DeepSeek reads long prompts about 5% faster on AMD Strix / Gorgon Halo, and three fixes.

- **Strix / Gorgon Halo:** DeepSeek reads a 16K prompt about 5% faster (the prompt is read in 4K-token pieces on these GPUs, with the same answers).
- **Long agent sessions:** a request whose messages carry their content as parts no longer fails with an error (#717).
- **Tool calls:** a tool call with an unclosed parameter tag is handled as a malformed call instead of failing the request (#706).
- **DeepSeek on Windows:** the in-place memory trim settings given in a config now reach the engine (#728).

Maya is free; if it helps you, you can sponsor it: https://github.com/sponsors/mw00

commits.message:
ds4: cap the default prompt chunk at 4K tokens on RDNA 3 / 3.5 (gfx11)

Strix Halo, Maya-XS, experts resident: a 16K prompt reads at 550 tok/s in chunks of 4096
against 524 at the 32K default (the first one after a start 475 -> 550). Same tokens on a
greedy 16K answer. DS4_CHUNK_GFX11=N sets the cap, 0 leaves the default.
Loop guard: content given as parts (#717)
Tool calls: an unclosed <parameter= tag is malformed, not a crash (#706)
DS4 in-place trim: read the config's name too (#728)

+def _text(c) -> str:
+    """A message's content as text: a string as is; a list of content parts (OpenAI form) by its text parts, joined.

+    if isinstance(c, str):
+        return c
+    if isinstance(c, list):
